_readme: Hand-written corrections to what the catalogs report about one model.
Every entry names provider, exact model ids, the guidance fields it
overrides, a note saying what was observed and when, and expiresWhen
saying what observation would retire it. A machine never writes here;
the probe rig (scripts/probe) writes candidates to tmp/, a person promotes.
Empty at launch and allowed to stay empty forever.

JSON-object mode is still listed and untested.
